  • Partner with us

For over seven years, AVIAVENTURA has been at the forefront of airline representation in Indonesia, offering dedicated General Sales and Services Agent (GSSA) solutions that drive results. Our approach is simple yet powerful: a dedicated team for each airline, ensuring unwavering focus, seamless operations, and unmatched market understanding.

Delivering Dedicated GSSA Success Across the Skies

As Africa’s largest carrier, Ethiopian Airlines sought a reliable partner to establish a strong foothold in the Indonesian market. AVIAVENTURA provided a dedicated sales and operations team, ensuring that Ethiopian Airlines not only increased its passenger sales but also optimized its cargo operations.

Our team worked tirelessly on strategic partnerships with travel agencies, corporate clients, and cargo handlers, leading to a steady increase in bookings and streamlined cargo logistics. Today, Ethiopian Airlines enjoys an established and growing presence in the region, backed by our market expertise and operational excellence.

With its strategic routes connecting Asia and Europe, Uzbekistan Airways needed a strong local presence to effectively penetrate Indonesia’s aviation sector. AVIAVENTURA took charge of sales, marketing, and administrative operations, ensuring smooth coordination between the airline and local authorities.

Our personalized approach, including direct engagement with travel agents and corporate partners, resulted in a significant rise in ticket sales. Additionally, our hands-on management of cargo sales and compliance led to improved efficiency in freight movement, solidifying Uzbekistan Airways’ reputation in the market.

More Than Just a GSSA

A Strategic Aviation Partner At AVIAVENTURA, we don’t just represent airlines; we empower them to succeed. Whether it’s increasing passenger sales, optimizing cargo operations, or navigating regulatory complexities, our dedicated approach ensures that our partners achieve sustainable growth in Indonesia’s dynamic aviation market. If you’re looking for a GSSA that prioritizes accountability, efficiency, and results, AVIAVENTURA is your trusted aviation partner. Let’s take your airline to new heights together.

Be Our Partner

Since 2016, AVIAVENTURA has proudly served as a trusted GSA in Indonesia, managing operations for over eight airlines. Our commitment to personalized service and market expertise ensures that partnering with us means your airline will achieve sustained success in the Indonesian market.
